name: ProbabilityTheory.variance_sum_pi
type: {ι : Type u} → [Fintype ι] → {Ω : ι → Type v} → {mΩ : ∀ i, MeasurableSpace (Ω i)} → {μ : ∀ i, MeasureTheory.Measure (Ω i)} → [∀ i, MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] → {X : ∀ i, Ω i → ℝ} → (∀ i, MeasureTheory.MemLp (X i) 2 (μ i)) → ProbabilityTheory.variance (fun ω => ∑ i, X i (ω i)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi μ) = ∑ i, ProbabilityTheory.variance (X i) (μ i)
provides: Variance of a sum of separate coordinate functions under a finite product probability law equals the sum of component variances, assuming square integrability.
type_review: Full theorem, independence-from-product proof and dependent measurable-space parameters inspected; manually expanded, not compiled.
